basics.name: Juan Antonio López Maragaño
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.pitch: I build and evolve software products across frontend, backend and integrations. I have hands-on experience on AI-driven products and existing codebases.
basics.summary: Civil Engineer in Computer Science from Universidad Austral de Chile and Software Engineer with professional experience across frontend, backend, integrations and automation. I've worked on maintaining and extending existing systems as well as building new solutions end-to-end, with experience on AI-driven products. I'm focused on full-stack development, scalable systems, software architecture and applied AI.
